entries.name: OfficeCLI Academic Paper

OpenRA-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill: the install section is replaced by a prerequisite check (officecli must already be installed via OpenRA's approved CLI path; the skill only verifies officecli --version) and an Apache-2.0 §4(b) modification notice is added; everything else is upstream text.
